title: Billable invoices still send their invoice webhooks, $0 included
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a webhook subscription for the test organization pointed at a request-catching page the tester can read. Subscribe it to invoice.created and invoice.paid.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, with one line at $0.00 priced by hand.
custom_steps:
1. In ShopView, invoice work order 1.
  2. Open the request-catching page to read the webhook requests.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The $0 invoice is created and shows as Paid.

Step 2:

  • invoice.created and invoice.paid arrived for work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11833 (Story 11, Open API and webhooks)

  • S11-N2: “If a consumer subscribed to invoice webhooks only, it receives nothing for internal and no-charge work orders; the work order status webhook is the signal.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Regular work orders, invoicing, payments, discounts, credits and the customer portal behave exactly as they do today.”
